name.title: Name
name.description: Name for this Landroid platform (shown in the Homebridge log).

email.title: eMail
email.description: The email address of your worx account

pwd.title: Password
pwd.description: The password of your worx account

cloud.title: Cloud Type
cloud.description: The used cloud - worx, kress or landxcape

rainsensor.title: Enable rain sensor
rainsensor.description: Adds a 'Leak' sensor that shows the state of the mowers rain sensor. Note that you might have to reload all mowers once to enable this.

homesensor.title: Enable home sensor
homesensor.description: Adds a 'Home' sensor that shows the state of the mowers. If in home position sensor is closed. Note that you might have to reload all mowers once to enable this.

partymode.title: Enable PartyMode switch
partymode.description: Adds a switch that enables PartyMode on supported mowers

edgecut.title: Enable Edge Cut switch
edgecut.description: Adds a switch that starts a one-time border/edge cut on supported mowers. Turning it off sends the mower home.

reload.title: Reload All Mowers
reload.description: Clears and reloads all mowers from the cloud, set and reboot HomeBridge, then unset again.

debug.title: Debug Mode
debug.description: Shows additional debug info in the log

mowdata.title: Mowing Data Logging
mowdata.description: Shows additional mowing data in the log
